text: {"lessons":["I sold winners early and later bought A, B and C at higher prices; I should judge each trade by its current risk and prospects, not by my purchase price or fear of admitting a mistake.","After buying in Period 7, I held through losses without trading; holding is fine only when it still fits my plan, so I should review positions calmly rather than react to daily swings or avoid a decision.","My account moved both up and down, and those changes do not predict what comes next; I should size trades carefully, preserve cash, and avoid chasing recent performance."]}
